title: phoneuse-agent farm manifest
description: Single source of truth for a phoneuse-agent phone fleet. One object per physical phone. Index is the only thing you allocate by hand; ssh_port / adb_port / portal_port are derived as base + index by farm/render_manifest.py unless explicitly pinned.

port_base.description: Base ports. index i => sshd base+i, adb base+i, portal base+i. Fixed by convention; change only with a matching controller change.

defaults.description: Values applied to any node that omits them.

index.description: Stable 0-based slot. Drives every port. Never renumber an enrolled node; append.

serial.description: adb serial (USB) that also becomes the log directory name.

name.description: Short human name, node-NN. node-NN matches index NN-1 (node-01 = index 0).

role.description: Free-text role tag surfaced by the control plane.

tailscale_hostname.description: Mesh DNS name the controller uses. Must be unique in the tailnet.

tailscale_ip.description: Filled in after enrollment (tailscale status). Optional in the manifest.

lan_ip.description: WLAN IPv4 used for adb-over-TCP. Prefer a DHCP reservation / static lease per phone.

adb_endpoint.description: Explicit host:port for adb. Alternative to lan_ip when the port cannot be derived.

ssh_port.description: Termux sshd port. Derived = 8022 + index; pin only to document a deviation.

adb_port.description: adb-over-TCP port the phone listens on. Derived = 5555 + index.

portal_port.description: On-device HTTP control portal port. Derived = 8080 + index.

admin_number.description: E.164 number this node's agent reports to / receives SMS from.

brain_provider.description: LLM backing this node's agent, e.g. ollama:qwen3:8b, openai_like:http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1, guiowl.

wa_account.description: Optional WhatsApp account/number this phone is signed into. null when unused.

usb.description: Physical USB position. Needed for uhubctl power-cycling and hub-tier budget.

controller.description: XHCI controller label/host, e.g. ctrl0 / usb-host-1

enabled.description: false = keep the slot but stop rendering/monitoring it.
